scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Bianca sits with her ankle on pillows directing Tiago's bread kneading and Camila's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Rafael chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Tiago and Bianca tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Camila, Helena, and Jorge lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Otavio nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Camila and Jorge convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Helena to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Helena's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Bianca, Rafael, and Tiago clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Otavio, Camila, and Helena learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Otavio's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
